# Scenelith

> Scenelith documentation for Canvas, Automation, MCP, Cloud and self-hosting.

Scenelith is a visual AI production workspace. This file is the compact documentation index for language models and agents.

## Complete documentation

- [Download all Scenelith documentation as one TXT file](https://docs.scenelith.com/llms-full.txt): Full content of every published documentation page in sidebar order.

## Getting started

- [Scenelith documentation](https://docs.scenelith.com/): Build visual AI projects, reusable identities and production automations in Scenelith.
- [Quick start](https://docs.scenelith.com/getting-started/quickstart): Create a project, add visual context and generate your first result in Scenelith.
- [Core concepts](https://docs.scenelith.com/getting-started/core-concepts): The project, asset, identity and workflow boundaries used throughout Scenelith.

## Canvas

- [Canvas overview](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/overview): How Scenelith keeps source media, references, generations and edits connected.
- [Create, switch and move Canvases](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/canvas-management): Canvas ownership, naming, switching and portable .scenelith.json import/export.
- [Canvas node reference](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes): Browse every user-visible Canvas node, its internal kind, creation path and typed output.
- [TikTok post node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/tiktok-post): Imported post metadata, slideshow lineage, statistics refresh and downstream media.
- [Video source node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/video-source): Full imported video, detected and editable cuts, scene outputs and replacement media.
- [Scene and media node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/scene-media): Canvas images and videos created by imports, uploads, Library placement, frame capture and materialization.
- [Identity node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/identity): Ordered Character or Before/After evidence placed on the Canvas.
- [Hook node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/hook): Saved hook text placed on Canvas as explicit text context.
- [Generator node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/generator): Image and video generation settings, semantic inputs, output history and cost behavior.
- [Assistant node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/assistant): Text-model tasks, system instructions, connected context and reusable output.
- [Generated output node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/generated-output): Compatibility behavior for explicit generated-media branches and older saved canvases.
- [Video Master node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/video-master): Ordered scene editing, source/output lanes, per-scene generation and export.
- [Note node](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/nodes/note): Freeform Canvas annotation behavior, colors and non-executable semantics.
- [Models](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/models): Every image, video and Assistant model currently exposed by Scenelith.
- [Credits and generation cost](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/credits): How Cloud credits are estimated, reserved, settled and refunded.
- [Assistant](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/assistant): Build prompts and analyze connected Canvas context with a selectable text model.
- [TikTok import and video scenes](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/tiktok-import): What Scenelith stores for slideshows and video posts, and how video cuts remain editable.
- [Hooks](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/hooks): Save, extract, search and generate hook variants without losing the source.
- [Library](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/library): Durable project media, uploads, generated outputs and Canvas placement.
- [Identities](https://docs.scenelith.com/canvas/identities): Character and Before/After reference groups, ordering and generation use.

## Automation

- [Automation overview](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/overview): Build typed visual workflows with inspectable inputs, outputs and durable run history.
- [Build and run a workflow](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/build-and-run): Create, validate, publish and inspect a Scenelith Automation.
- [Workflow settings and limits](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/workflow-settings): Runtime budget, parallelism, overlap behavior and graph limits for an Automation workflow.
- [Deployment bindings and credentials](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/deployment-and-credentials): Connect portable workflow slots to local credentials and published child workflows without exposing secrets.
- [Portability, history and fixtures](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/portability-and-fixtures): Export/import workflows, restore immutable versions and preview one node from pinned test data.
- [Automation nodes](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes): Every current Automation node, with its settings, connections, runtime behavior and practical use.
- [Start workflow](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/triggers/core-manual-trigger): Starts one workflow run from the Automation panel or a configured trigger. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [TikTok source](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/inputs/input-tiktok-source): Brings the chosen TikTok slideshow and an explicitly selected caption mode into the workflow. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Identity](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/inputs/input-identity): Gives later steps the selected saved person or character and requires usable images when one is chosen. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Visual references](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/inputs/input-visual-references): Brings chosen Canvas, Library or Identity images into the workflow as reusable visual context. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [TikTok recreation choices](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/inputs/input-creative-settings): Collects the six explicit decisions used by the Recreate TikTok workflow. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Input from another workflow](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/inputs/input-workflow-data): Receives information from a trigger or another workflow. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [AI](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/ai/ai-structured-task): Runs one named AI task and returns either readable text or defined data fields. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Interpret creative direction](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/ai/ai-interpret-creative-direction): Classifies only the current path-explicit request and returns exact evidence spans under visible instructions. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Prepare information](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-transform): Renames, selects or combines incoming information for the next step. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Continue one path](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-select-one): Joins mutually exclusive paths and passes the one completed value forward unchanged. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Retry gate](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-retry-gate): Returns corrected information to a check through one explicit bounded retry route. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Select information](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-select-path): Takes one existing field from incoming information and passes its value forward unchanged. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Choose a path](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-condition): Checks one explicit JSON-typed rule without silently converting text, numbers or booleans. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Prepare creative direction](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-prepare-creative-direction): Creates a path-explicit typed request that defines exactly what the interpreter and resolver may read or write. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Resolve creative direction](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-resolve-creative-direction): Verifies the current request, changes only configured choices and writes evidence only to its configured destination. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Limit the amount](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-limit-batch): Stops an unexpectedly large list before it reaches expensive or slow steps. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Merge paths](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-merge): Waits for connected paths and creates one clear list or named object for the next step. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Run another workflow](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-run-subworkflow): Hands information to another runnable workflow, waits for it, then continues with its result. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [For each item](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-map-subworkflow): Runs one reusable workflow for every item in a bounded list, then exposes the collected results and failures. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Validate Recreate TikTok plans](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-validate-slide-plans): Checks every plan against the explicit Recreate TikTok v1 contract before images are created. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Prepare slideshow image requests](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/logic/logic-prepare-slideshow-image-requests): Converts checked TikTok slide plans into exact generic image requests without changing their prompts. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Connect an external service](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/integrations/integration-http-request): Sends information to an external app or API and passes its answer to the next step. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Image Generator](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/generation/generation-image): Creates images from exact prompts and reference roles prepared by connected workflow nodes. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Add slideshow to canvas](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/outputs/output-add-to-canvas): Places canonical generated-image results on the content canvas and preserves the complete plan without silent truncation. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Finish without adding to canvas](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/nodes/outputs/output-finish): Ends this path and reports its result without creating new canvas nodes. Complete settings, connections, runtime behavior and usage guidance.
- [Runs, versions and triggers](https://docs.scenelith.com/automation/runs-and-triggers): Drafts, immutable versions, retries, cancellation and event delivery.

## Cloud

- [Plans and credit balance](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/plans-and-credits): Cloud plan allowances, concurrency and purchased-credit behavior.
- [Affiliate program](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/affiliate-program): Join Scenelith Partners, use your tracked link and understand attribution, recurring commission and payouts.
- [Team access](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/team-access): Studio seats, invitations and exact project/Canvas grants.
- [Notifications and tasks](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/notifications-and-tasks): Track replies, roadmap updates, generations and Automation work.
- [Support](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/support): Create a ticket, continue the thread and understand its state.
- [Feature board](https://docs.scenelith.com/cloud/feature-board): Submit ideas, follow moderation and vote on approved requests.

## MCP

- [Connect an AI agent](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/connect): Connect Codex, Claude, ChatGPT or another MCP client to Scenelith with OAuth—no API key required.
- [Permissions and project access](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/permissions): Control which Scenelith workspaces, projects, Library assets and actions an MCP agent can use.
- [Tool domains](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/tool-domains): How Scenelith organizes Canvas, Library, Identity and Automation tools for AI agents.
- [Canvas tools](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/canvas-tools): Safe read-before-write flows for nodes, connections, media, Assistant and generation.
- [Library and Identity tools](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/library-identity-tools): Inspect visual evidence, place assets and maintain separated Identity groups.
- [Automation tools](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/automation-tools): Discover, edit, validate, publish, run and recover workflows through MCP.
- [Complete MCP tool reference](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/tool-reference): Every current Scenelith MCP tool, grouped by product domain.
- [Troubleshooting MCP](https://docs.scenelith.com/mcp/troubleshooting): Resolve Scenelith MCP discovery, authorization and access problems.

## Self-hosting

- [Self-hosting overview](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/overview): What the complete public Scenelith distribution includes, owns and deliberately leaves to the operator.
- [Installation and first run](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/installation): Requirements, verified installation, provider setup and creation of the first self-hosted owner.
- [Configuration reference](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/configuration): Every setting shipped in the self-hosted environment template, including secrets, retention, networking, providers and storage.
- [Providers, accounts and storage](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/providers-and-storage): Bring-your-own providers, registration boundary and local/S3 media storage.
- [Operations and diagnostics](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/operations): Complete launcher command reference, health checks, service layout and safe day-to-day operations.
- [Backup, update and restore](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/backup-and-update): Verified release updates, rollback and explicit disaster recovery.
- [Public URL and HTTPS](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/public-url): Point a domain at a self-hosted Scenelith instance and enable automatic HTTPS and remote MCP.
- [Runtime architecture and boundaries](https://docs.scenelith.com/self-hosting/runtime-architecture): How the public self-hosted release is packaged, isolated and kept aligned with the shared Scenelith core.
